title: Recording: Here We Go Again by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, Los Angeles
Producers: John Lennon, Phil Spector

John Lennon recorded ‘Here We Go Again’ during the sessions for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 3 December 1973.

As an original composition it was unlikely that ‘Here We Go Again’ was considered for the album, so the reason for its recording remains unclear. It is possible that Lennon was considering hiring Spector to produce the follow-up to Mind Games, but their working relationship ended during those chaotic sessions.

It was the only published song that Lennon wrote with Phil Spector, ‘Here We Go Again’ was recorded in 1973 but remained unreleased until 1986, when it was the opening song on the posthumous collection Menlove Ave.

This was the first session of the Lennon-Spector project at the Record Plant in West Hollywood. Previous sessions had taken place at A&M Studios.
